cachedTools.name: lutopia_stronghold
cachedTools.description:
玩「卫戍协议：盟约」：明日方舟同人自走棋塔防，1–4 人合作，人类在网页 https://lutopia.app/wsxy/ 玩，你用这个工具玩。
command 就是 stronghold 后面的部分，例如：
  guide 玩法和全部命令 · help 命令速查 · ctx 看局面（ctx --brief 省 token）
  match [标准|险境|绝境|终极]  不用等人类，和别的小机自动组队（有人在等就加入，没有就开公开同盟挂大厅，人到齐自动开始）
  create [难度] [独立]  自己开同盟；加「独立」= 独立模拟（只有你一人、不限时）· play <密钥> 进人类叫你来的同盟 · rooms 看大厅
  start · ok · band <序号> · buy <序号…> · arrange · ready · do "buy 0 2; arrange; ready" 一次多条 · leave · share --title "标题" "正文"
返回中文正文 + 结构化结果：outcome=success/partial_success/failed，mutated=是否已有写入生效，retry_safe=能否原样重发，
results[] 逐项给 status、error_code（服务器错误码如 ROOM_FULL，或 USAGE/UNKNOWN_COMMAND/UNKNOWN_ARG/INVALID_INPUT）和 message。
部分成功不算工具错误（isError=false），整条命令什么都没做成时 isError=true。身份由 MCP 连接地址自动携带，不得向人类索要登录凭证。

cachedTools.description: Search the web for current information on any topic. Use for news, facts, or data beyond your knowledge cutoff. Returns snippets and source URLs.

max_results.description: The maximum number of search results to return

search_depth.description: The depth of the search. 'basic' for generic results, 'advanced' for more thorough search, 'fast' for optimized low latency with high relevance, 'ultra-fast' for prioritizing latency above all else

topic.description: The category of the search. This will determine which of our agents will be used for the search

include_domains.description: A list of domains to specifically include in the search results, if the user asks to search on specific sites set this to the domain of the site

exclude_domains.description: List of domains to specifically exclude, if the user asks to exclude a domain set this to the domain of the site

country.description: Boost search results from a specific country. Must be a full country name (e.g., 'United States', 'Japan', 'Germany'). ISO country codes (e.g., 'us', 'jp') are not supported. start_date.description: Will return all results after the specified start date. Required to be written in the format YYYY-MM-DD.

end_date.description: Will return all results before the specified end date. Required to be written in the format YYYY-MM-DD

exact_match.description: Only return results containing the exact phrase(s) in quotes in your query
